responsibility: Contains helper code shared by the RTL GCSE implementations for tracking memory modifications and computing transparency of expressions with respect to register and memory clobbers. In particular, it records canonicalized MEM stores per basic block, notes blocks containing calls, and walks RTL expressions to clear transparency bits when referenced regs or aliased memory locations are modified, supplying common support routines used by the main GCSE/PRE code.
same_name_distinction: Implements the shared GCSE helper routines declared in gcc/gcse-common.h. Unlike the header’s common data structures and prototypes, this source file contains the code that records per-basic-block MEM modifications and call effects and computes expression transparency by walking RTL and aliasing against canonicalized modified-memory lists.
